primary_outcome: Per-session OKX entry-to-mid markout after a Binance accumulated $2 jump, using 50ms delayed executable bid/ask entry, 5bps entry fee and the 1s signal-relative follower mid. Not round-trip profit.
missingness_rule: Retain every planned slot and failed attempt. No backfill, favorable retry or pooling with v1/v2. Any missing planned slot prevents a conclusive full-study claim.
holdout_rule: No outcome estimation until the UTC day after the final study date. Rehearsals never enter study estimates.
trigger_dependency: Authenticated operator dispatch with an explicit intended UTC timestamp. Timing reliability remains unestablished until prospective qualification; no autonomous scheduler or external service configured.
freeze_prerequisites: Latest three prospective attempts all healthy, on time and remotely restored across at least two UTC dates
Current source and protocol match the qualified recordings
Commit future UTC dates, source hashes, quality gates, estimator and report integration before study collection
Document operator availability; absence or lateness remains a failed/missing attempt
